principles: A process fact should have one executable source of truth.
The fix should remain narrower than the policy it reports.
Frozen historical evidence must retain its original semantics.
drivers: Current JSON telemetry contradicts runtime enforcement.
All active stories can consume the current result artifact.
A future budget change must not require remembering a second number.

options.name: Reference the canonical constant and pin the source mapping
pros: Focused regression catches the exact drift class
cons: Smoke assertion inspects source structure rather than generating a full-suite artifact

options.name: Keep the numeric field and update it manually
Extract a new artifact-builder abstraction
pros: Could unit-test the entire result object
cons: Unnecessary surface area for a one-field defect
Slower review and larger regression risk

chosen: Reference the canonical constant and pin the source mapping
rationale: It directly removes the duplicate process fact and adds a discriminating check at the writer without changing runtime policy or historical receipts.

preMortem.scenario: The production field is fixed but the smoke never examines the writer.
preMortem.trigger: A later edit restores a numeric initializer and tests remain green.
preMortem.consequence: Current receipts again disagree with runtime enforcement.
preMortem.mitigation: Assert the exact canonical initializer and reject any numeric performanceBudgetMs initializer.

preMortem.scenario: The story accidentally changes the budget policy while fixing telemetry.
preMortem.trigger: FULL_SUITE_BUDGET_MS or scheduling logic appears in the diff beyond the field reference.
preMortem.consequence: A reporting fix changes suite behavior and destabilizes other stories.
preMortem.mitigation: Freeze allowed paths and review the final diff for a one-line production substitution.

preMortem.scenario: Historical B-9812 proof is rewritten to current semantics.
preMortem.trigger: verify-full-suite-contract.mjs or frozen receipts enter the diff.
preMortem.consequence: Historical evidence no longer describes the run that produced it.
preMortem.mitigation: Keep those paths explicitly excluded and unchanged.
